entries.note: Status list of the Bussgods API documentation (FRAM WCF service). The fraktsedel is registered before the goods are handed in.
Handed in at a Bussgods agent or terminal; a second one can follow at the next station.
Forwarded from a terminal towards the next station.
Status list of the Bussgods API documentation (FRAM WCF service). Dispatched.
Status list of the Bussgods API documentation (FRAM WCF service). Registered for distribution at the receiving end.
Status list of the Bussgods API documentation (FRAM WCF service). On the way to the receiving agent or the customer.
Status list of the Bussgods API documentation (FRAM WCF service). Missorted, the shipment is delayed.
Arrived at the receiving agent; the tracker adds that Bussgods texts the receiver when goods have arrived and can be collected. It also precedes a door delivery.
Handed out to the receiver at the agent.

Delivered to the door by the home-delivery service; the tracker script names its two API codes Delivered and DeliveredWithoutSignature. A 2015 capture shows it at a terminal before arrival at the receiving agent.
Status list of the Bussgods API documentation (FRAM WCF service). Door delivery failed.
Status list of the Bussgods API documentation (FRAM WCF service). The cash-on-delivery amount was paid out; not a movement of the parcel.
Status list of the Bussgods API documentation (FRAM WCF service). The shipment was given a new number; not a movement of the parcel.
